verdict.rationale: Jeeves supports exporting transaction data (CSV exports via MCP, one-click sync with NetSuite/QuickBooks/Xero, transaction exports with reference IDs) but there is no evidence of a comprehensive full-account data export or an explicit account-closure/data-portability guarantee covering all user data (cards, expenses, receipts, permissions, etc.) in open formats. missing for 10: full-account data export covering all data types (not just transactions), documented open-format export (e.g., JSON/CSV for full account), explicit 'leave and take your data' guarantee or data portability policy.
